keyPhrases.text: Credit helmer Jamie Lloyd with an original concept
a lack of restraint spoils the fun
making it all seem too big...too much...over the top

reasoning: Mixed review that credits the original concept and several strong performances (Poesy, Page) but criticizes the execution as excessive and overwhelming. The director's concept is praised but its implementation is seen as spoiling the material. More criticism than unqualified praise, placing it in mixed-negative territory.
